svg.title: microcosm — the economy in miniature
svg.desc: A nation is millions of households. We build a synthetic one that stands in for them all. A dot-field on an exact lattice resolves into the Microcosm operator — a world-ring and its point, in verdigris.

g.text: that stands in for them all.

svg.text: calibrated synthetic microdata, built in the open · a PolicyEngine project
